title: Read the exact shipped source for each project
when: Configuring or starting shared release, then retrying it
need: A workflow input_binding names a registered project branch; composition freezes one commit per project and enrolls work actually shipped. Completion is per-project exact source. Unused bound sources can refresh before dispatch; consumed sources stay sealed. A landing that changes containment between preview and apply rolls preparation back and retries up to three total attempts without repeating backup or rehearsal. Exhaustion names candidate_containment_attestation_stale and teaches re-driving the same run; other refusals retain their repair. Required compatibility proof currently dispatches main and refuses a different consumer commit. Consumer-tag binding waits until session-optional tag creation is served. Refused release-output recording fails visibly and recovers the shipped receipt without redeploying.
surface: delivery.md binding-based multi-project delivery lines 11–87; flow runner contract.
gap: The future entry should route to this real mechanism and its source-access prerequisites. Item dependency and delivery-source evidence remain distinct.
